first_step_test: One broad head contour and two attached ear circles form a useful, recognizable teddy-bear start in their final positions without detached facial marks.

source.notes: Planned six-panel handmade graphite and restrained colored-pencil contact sheet; rejected iterations remain private under drafts/teddy-bear-with-stitched-patch/rejected-progressions/.

frames.instruction: Near the upper half of the page, draw one broad rounded head. Attach one round ear to each upper corner, keeping the two ear circles similar in size and leaving open paper below for the body.
frames.visible_job: Establish the final head silhouette and two attached ears.

frames.step_name: Add the seated body and paws
frames.instruction: From beneath the head, sweep two curves outward into a pear-shaped seated body. At the bottom, add one bent leg and oval paw on each side, draw one large inner pad oval inside each paw, then join the paws with a short belly curve.
frames.visible_job: Attach the seated body and two planted paws to the established head.

frames.instruction: Curve one arm from each shoulder toward the belly. Center a low oval muzzle between two small eyes, then add a triangular nose, one short center line, and two shallow mouth curves.
frames.visible_job: Add two attached arms and the complete simple teddy-bear face.

frames.step_name: Sew on the patch and seams
frames.instruction: Add a small crescent inside each ear. Draw a rounded rectangular patch on the lower-right belly, then cross its edge with exactly seven short stitches: two at the top, three at the left, and two at the bottom. Place one short center seam below the muzzle, then add exactly three short toe marks above each established paw-pad oval.
frames.visible_job: Add both inner ears, one belly patch, seven stitches, the center seam, and three toe marks on each paw.

frames.instruction: Break the silhouette with exactly five small fur-tick groups: one on top of the head, one at each cheek, and one at each outer body side. Then draw one broken oval shadow beneath the bear.
frames.visible_job: Complete the five fur-tick groups and ground shadow before color and shading.

final_step.instruction: Layer warm brown colored pencil over the established bear, dusty rose inside the ears and paw pads, muted teal on the patch, and cool gray in the shadow. Deepen the graphite around the muzzle, seams, stitches, and fur ticks while leaving small paper highlights.
final_step.visible_job: Color and shade only the established contours, seams, patch, paws, fur ticks, face, and shadow.
adds: warm-brown, dusty-rose, muted-teal, and cool-gray color on established regions

visual_review.first_step_observation: The saved first crop contains one broad open-bottom head contour and two attached outer ears in their final positions. The marks are large, connected, and copyable without relying on future facial or body details.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Reviewed the six saved square crops individually and all five adjacent pairs at readable size. The sequence progresses from head, to seated body and pad ovals, to arms and face, to sewn details, to fur and shadow, then one restrained color pass. Every named landmark remains at the same anchor after introduction; no keeper line disappears or moves.

transitions.observed_addition: The seated pear-shaped body connects into the two open head ends; two oval paws, their inner pad ovals, and the short belly curve appear on one baseline.
transitions.instruction_match: The saved second crop follows the instruction from the open head edges into the body and establishes both paws and pad ovals before any face or arms.

transitions.observed_addition: Two curved arms attach at the shoulders and end against the belly; the oval muzzle, two eyes, triangular nose, center line, and paired mouth curves complete the face.
transitions.instruction_match: The image adds exactly the arms and facial strokes named by the instruction while retaining the head, ears, body, legs, paws, and pad ovals unchanged.

transitions.observed_addition: Both inner-ear crescents, the vertical center seam, lower-right rectangular patch, seven edge stitches, and three toe marks above each existing pad oval appear together.
transitions.instruction_match: The crop shows the requested sewn-detail pass: two top, three left, and two bottom patch stitches, plus six toe marks and no premature fur or shadow.

transitions.observed_addition: Five distinct fur-tick groups appear at the top, both cheeks, and both body sides, and one broken graphite shadow appears beneath the paws.
transitions.instruction_match: The fifth crop adds only the five named fur locations and ground shadow; the face, limbs, pad ovals, toe marks, patch, seam, and seven stitches all remain fixed.

transitions.observed_addition: Warm-brown pencil fills the established bear, dusty rose fills the ear and paw-pad regions, muted teal fills the patch, and cool gray deepens the same shadow.
transitions.instruction_match: The final crop performs the written coloring and value pass only; every contour, seven stitch positions, six toe marks, five fur groups, facial landmark, and limb stays in place.
